units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 2|Medical crews await you once you land, and it takes several hours to evacuate the injured. Doctors, or maybe paramedics, swarm over them to triage, treat, and prepare them for transport. Three who died during the flight are treated with respect and carried off the <ship>.|338|0
units.english: Medical crews await you once you land, and it takes several hours to evacuate the injured. Doctors, or maybe paramedics, swarm over them to triage, treat, and prepare them for transport. Three who died during the flight are treated with respect and carried off the <ship>.
units.italian: Squadre mediche vi aspettano appena atterrate, e ci vogliono diverse ore per evacuare i feriti. Dottori, o forse paramedici, si riversano su di loro per il triage, le cure e i preparativi per il trasporto. Tre che sono morti durante il volo vengono trattati con rispetto e portati fuori dalla <ship>.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 2|	When you make it to the spaceport, you find a message from the Quarg. "Bold human! With profuse thanks we offer you for helping the stranded Korath. The Korath ever mourn the loss of their worlds, and, from time to time, brave their dangers. They salvage what they can among the ruins, and seek out worlds where they may one day live again. For the young, this gives them hope, but sometimes they are caught, and the Efreti are reminded why they live crushed together around these few stars."|339|0
units.english: When you make it to the spaceport, you find a message from the Quarg. "Bold human! With profuse thanks we offer you for helping the stranded Korath. The Korath ever mourn the loss of their worlds, and, from time to time, brave their dangers. They salvage what they can among the ruins, and seek out worlds where they may one day live again. For the young, this gives them hope, but sometimes they are caught, and the Efreti are reminded why they live crushed together around these few stars."
units.italian: Quando arrivate allo spazioporto, trovate un messaggio dei Quarg. "Umano audace! Con copiosa gratitudine vi ricompensiamo per aver aiutato i Korath rimasti in secca. I Korath piangono da sempre la perdita dei loro mondi e, di tanto in tanto, sfidano i loro pericoli. Recuperano ciò che possono fra le rovine e cercano mondi dove un giorno possano vivere di nuovo. Ai giovani questo dà speranza, ma a volte vengono presi, e agli Efreti si ricorda perché vivono pigiati intorno a queste poche stelle."

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 2|	Your communicator notifies you of a payment of <payment>.|340|0
units.english: Your communicator notifies you of a payment of <payment>.
units.italian: Il vostro comunicatore vi notifica un pagamento di <payment>.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 3|name|345|0
units.english: Recover the fallen crew of the <EDC-ship>
units.italian: Recupera l'equipaggio caduto della <EDC-ship>

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 3|description|346|0
units.english: Recover the bodies of the dead <EDC-ship> crew on <destination> and return them to <origin>.
units.italian: Recupera i corpi dell'equipaggio morto della <EDC-ship> su <destination> e riportali a <origin>.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 3|Before you can leave, a delegation of Korath approach you somewhat hesitantly. They are dressed in what appears to be much finer clothing than most Korath you have met, certainly nothing you would wear to do work in a spaceport. As they make the traditional gesture of greeting, which you return, you are curious both as to what they want and how they will ask.|356|0
units.english: Before you can leave, a delegation of Korath approach you somewhat hesitantly. They are dressed in what appears to be much finer clothing than most Korath you have met, certainly nothing you would wear to do work in a spaceport. As they make the traditional gesture of greeting, which you return, you are curious both as to what they want and how they will ask.
units.italian: Prima che possiate partire, una delegazione di Korath vi si avvicina con una certa esitazione. Indossano abiti che sembrano molto più raffinati di quelli della maggior parte dei Korath che avete incontrato, di certo nulla che mettereste per lavorare in uno spazioporto. Mentre fanno il tradizionale gesto di saluto, che ricambiate, siete incuriositi sia da ciò che vogliono sia da come lo chiederanno.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 3|	One of them takes a small case out of a pocket and removes a black device that looks like three triangles hooked together. He hisses at it for a moment and it rises out of his hand. The air around it begins to shimmer, followed by the appearance of a life-sized hologram of a Quarg.|357|0
units.english: One of them takes a small case out of a pocket and removes a black device that looks like three triangles hooked together. He hisses at it for a moment and it rises out of his hand. The air around it begins to shimmer, followed by the appearance of a life-sized hologram of a Quarg.
units.italian: Uno di loro tira fuori da una tasca una piccola custodia e ne estrae un dispositivo nero che sembra tre triangoli agganciati insieme. Ci sibila sopra per un momento e quello si solleva dalla sua mano. L'aria intorno comincia a tremolare, seguita dalla comparsa di un ologramma a grandezza naturale di un Quarg.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 3|	"Salutations, far traveler," the Quarg rumbles. "These Korath-Friends are the princes of the clan that you assisted. While grateful for the living, they cannot fully mourn those that lie dead. They beseech you travel back to <planet> and bring their lost ones home to <origin>."|358|0
units.english: "Salutations, far traveler," the Quarg rumbles. "These Korath-Friends are the princes of the clan that you assisted. While grateful for the living, they cannot fully mourn those that lie dead. They beseech you travel back to <planet> and bring their lost ones home to <origin>."
units.italian: "Salute, viaggiatore lontano," romba il Quarg. "Questi Amici dei Korath sono i principi del clan che avete soccorso. Grati per i vivi, non possono però piangere del tutto coloro che giacciono morti. Vi supplicano di tornare su <planet> e di riportare i loro perduti a casa, su <origin>."

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 3|	"I will bring them home."|360|0
units.english: "I will bring them home."
units.italian: "Li riporterò a casa."

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 3|	"I will if they pay me."|362|0
units.english: "I will if they pay me."
units.italian: "Lo farò, se mi pagano."

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 3|	"I won't risk my ship for the dead."|364|0
units.english: "I won't risk my ship for the dead."
units.italian: "Non rischio la mia nave per i morti."

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 3|	The leader of the group visibly sags as the Quarg translates your words. Two younger Korath bear him up as the group turns and leaves.|365|0
units.english: The leader of the group visibly sags as the Quarg translates your words. Two younger Korath bear him up as the group turns and leaves.
units.italian: Il capo del gruppo si affloscia visibilmente mentre il Quarg traduce le vostre parole. Due Korath più giovani lo sorreggono mentre il gruppo si volta e se ne va.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 3|	You hadn't realized how tense the group was until you saw them relax as your words reach them. They seem relieved at your answer.|369|0
units.english: You hadn't realized how tense the group was until you saw them relax as your words reach them. They seem relieved at your answer.
units.italian: Non avevate capito quanto fosse teso il gruppo finché non li avete visti rilassarsi appena le vostre parole li raggiungono. Sembrano sollevati dalla vostra risposta.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 3|	The group relaxes quickly as you see a ripple of relief and pride pass through them.|373|0
units.english: The group relaxes quickly as you see a ripple of relief and pride pass through them.
units.italian: Il gruppo si distende in fretta, e vedete passare tra loro un'onda di sollievo e di orgoglio.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 3|	The leader turns and speaks to you directly. His eyes never waver from yours even as you wait for the translation. "Efreti crews have families, as children learn by working with parents. For some families, three generations were lost. We will not try to salvage the ship, for none can bear to fly it. We offer you title to salvage the <EDC-ship> and carry our grief far from here."|376|0
units.english: The leader turns and speaks to you directly. His eyes never waver from yours even as you wait for the translation. "Efreti crews have families, as children learn by working with parents. For some families, three generations were lost. We will not try to salvage the ship, for none can bear to fly it. We offer you title to salvage the <EDC-ship> and carry our grief far from here."
units.italian: Il capo si volta e parla direttamente a voi. I suoi occhi non si staccano mai dai vostri mentre aspettate la traduzione. "Gli equipaggi Efreti hanno famiglie, perché i bambini imparano lavorando con i genitori. Per alcune famiglie sono andate perdute tre generazioni. Non tenteremo di recuperare la nave, perché nessuno ha il cuore di pilotarla. Vi offriamo il titolo per recuperare la <EDC-ship> e per portare il nostro lutto lontano da qui."

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 4|name|388|0
units.english: Recover the fallen of <EDC-ship>
units.italian: Recupera i caduti della <EDC-ship>

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 4|description|389|0
units.english: Return the bodies of the dead <EDC-ship> crew to <planet>.
units.italian: Riporta i corpi dell'equipaggio morto della <EDC-ship> su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 4|Locating the <EDC-ship>, you and your crew enter it wearing environment suits. It's been several days since the crash, and Korath ships run hot. This will be an unpleasant task in the suits and perhaps impossible without them.|397|0
units.english: Locating the <EDC-ship>, you and your crew enter it wearing environment suits. It's been several days since the crash, and Korath ships run hot. This will be an unpleasant task in the suits and perhaps impossible without them.
units.italian: Trovata la <EDC-ship>, voi e il vostro equipaggio vi entrate indossando tute ambientali. Sono passati diversi giorni dallo schianto, e le navi Korath sono roventi. Sarà un compito sgradevole con le tute, e forse impossibile senza.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 4|Locating the <EDC-ship>, you enter it wearing an environment suit. It's been several days since the crash, and Korath ships run hot. This will be an unpleasant task in the suit and perhaps impossible without it, especially with no crew helping you.|400|0
units.english: Locating the <EDC-ship>, you enter it wearing an environment suit. It's been several days since the crash, and Korath ships run hot. This will be an unpleasant task in the suit and perhaps impossible without it, especially with no crew helping you.
units.italian: Trovata la <EDC-ship>, vi entrate indossando una tuta ambientale. Sono passati diversi giorni dallo schianto, e le navi Korath sono roventi. Sarà un compito sgradevole con la tuta, e forse impossibile senza, soprattutto senza nessuno del vostro equipaggio ad aiutarvi.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 4|	While your engineer works on refreshing the atmosphere with outside air, the rest of the crew gathers the bodies and places them in the fibrous, vaguely egg-shaped coffins the Korath provided. As you move them to your cargo bay, you find they stack together like a clutch of eggs in a nest.|404|0
units.english: While your engineer works on refreshing the atmosphere with outside air, the rest of the crew gathers the bodies and places them in the fibrous, vaguely egg-shaped coffins the Korath provided. As you move them to your cargo bay, you find they stack together like a clutch of eggs in a nest.
units.italian: Mentre il vostro ingegnere lavora per rinfrescare l'atmosfera con aria esterna, il resto dell'equipaggio raccoglie i corpi e li depone nelle bare fibrose e vagamente a forma di uovo che i Korath hanno fornito. Mentre le spostate nella stiva, scoprite che si incastrano insieme come una covata di uova in un nido.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 4|	While your crewmate works on refreshing the atmosphere with outside air, you gather the bodies and place them in the fibrous, vaguely egg-shaped coffins the Korath provided. As you move them to your cargo bay, you find they stack together like a clutch of eggs in a nest.|407|0
units.english: While your crewmate works on refreshing the atmosphere with outside air, you gather the bodies and place them in the fibrous, vaguely egg-shaped coffins the Korath provided. As you move them to your cargo bay, you find they stack together like a clutch of eggs in a nest.
units.italian: Mentre il vostro compagno di equipaggio lavora per rinfrescare l'atmosfera con aria esterna, voi raccogliete i corpi e li deponete nelle bare fibrose e vagamente a forma di uovo che i Korath hanno fornito. Mentre le spostate nella stiva, scoprite che si incastrano insieme come una covata di uova in un nido.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 4|	One by one, you gather the bodies and place them in fibrous, vaguely egg-shaped coffins the Korath provided. As you move them to your cargo bay, you find they stack together like a clutch of eggs in a nest. It takes a while to refresh the atmosphere with outside air before the smell is tolerable.|410|0
units.english: One by one, you gather the bodies and place them in fibrous, vaguely egg-shaped coffins the Korath provided. As you move them to your cargo bay, you find they stack together like a clutch of eggs in a nest. It takes a while to refresh the atmosphere with outside air before the smell is tolerable.
units.italian: Uno alla volta, raccogliete i corpi e li deponete in bare fibrose e vagamente a forma di uovo che i Korath hanno fornito. Mentre le spostate nella stiva, scoprite che si incastrano insieme come una covata di uova in un nido. Ci vuole un po' perché l'aria esterna rinfreschi l'atmosfera e l'odore diventi tollerabile.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 4|	Returning to the Korath ship, you carefully gather all the personal effects you can find in the living quarters and box them for transport. You've no way of knowing if those Korath in the photographs you find are now safely recovering or lying in your hold.|414|0
units.english: Returning to the Korath ship, you carefully gather all the personal effects you can find in the living quarters and box them for transport. You've no way of knowing if those Korath in the photographs you find are now safely recovering or lying in your hold.
units.italian: Tornati sulla nave Korath, raccogliete con cura tutti gli effetti personali che riuscite a trovare negli alloggi e li imballate per il trasporto. Non avete modo di sapere se i Korath delle fotografie che trovate si stiano ora riprendendo al sicuro o giacciano nella vostra stiva.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 4|	The crew makes a last sweep to move debris, both to assess for repairs later and to make sure you haven't missed anyone, or parts of them. You clean and disinfect as best you can and return to your ship for the trip to <destination>.|416|0
units.english: The crew makes a last sweep to move debris, both to assess for repairs later and to make sure you haven't missed anyone, or parts of them. You clean and disinfect as best you can and return to your ship for the trip to <destination>.
units.italian: L'equipaggio fa un ultimo giro per spostare le macerie, sia per valutare eventuali riparazioni future sia per assicurarsi di non aver dimenticato nessuno, o parti di qualcuno. Pulite e disinfettate come meglio potete e tornate alla vostra nave per il viaggio verso <destination>.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 4|	As a precaution, you make a last sweep to move debris, both to assess for repairs later and to make sure you haven't missed anyone, or parts of them. You clean and disinfect as best you can and return to your ship for the trip to <destination>.|419|0
units.english: As a precaution, you make a last sweep to move debris, both to assess for repairs later and to make sure you haven't missed anyone, or parts of them. You clean and disinfect as best you can and return to your ship for the trip to <destination>.
units.italian: Per precauzione, fate un ultimo giro per spostare le macerie, sia per valutare eventuali riparazioni future sia per assicurarvi di non aver dimenticato nessuno, o parti di qualcuno. Pulite e disinfettate come meglio potete e tornate alla vostra nave per il viaggio verso <destination>.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 4|A crowd pours out of the spaceport when you land. It takes some time for the workers to establish barricades and clear a path so the transports can get to your cargo hold. A team in uniform greets you formally when you open the hatch, and you count the coffins together with them. Afterwards, you show them the boxes of possessions, which they handle with care. An officer thanks you and hands you a data chip that vaguely reminds you of a license.|432|0
units.english: A crowd pours out of the spaceport when you land. It takes some time for the workers to establish barricades and clear a path so the transports can get to your cargo hold. A team in uniform greets you formally when you open the hatch, and you count the coffins together with them. Afterwards, you show them the boxes of possessions, which they handle with care. An officer thanks you and hands you a data chip that vaguely reminds you of a license.
units.italian: Una folla si riversa dallo spazioporto quando atterrate. Ci vuole un po' perché gli operai stabiliscano sbarramenti e aprano un passaggio per far arrivare i trasporti alla vostra stiva. Una squadra in uniforme vi saluta formalmente quando aprite il portello, e contate le bare insieme a loro. Poi mostrate loro le scatole degli effetti personali, che maneggiano con cura. Un ufficiale vi ringrazia e vi consegna un chip dati che vi ricorda vagamente una licenza.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 4|	The crowd has been somber, but when the first coffin leaves your ship, they erupt in a cacophony of barking sounds. Some Korath try to rush forward but are held back by others, presumably their family.|433|0
units.english: The crowd has been somber, but when the first coffin leaves your ship, they erupt in a cacophony of barking sounds. Some Korath try to rush forward but are held back by others, presumably their family.
units.italian: La folla è stata composta, ma quando la prima bara esce dalla nave scoppia in una cacofonia di suoni che abbaiano. Alcuni Korath cercano di precipitarsi avanti ma vengono trattenuti da altri, presumibilmente i loro familiari.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 4|	Rather than intrude on their grief, you return to your ship, slotting the data chip you received into your systems. Unfortunately, the information is in an alien language, so you set it aside and work on a plan to salvage the <EDC-ship>. Gathering some notes on the ship and the number of crew they were carrying, it's clear that you will need to carry at least 66 additional crew that you can communicate with to be able to salvage it. The closest system that comes to mind with many human speakers is on Greenwater, in Hai space.|434|0
units.english: Rather than intrude on their grief, you return to your ship, slotting the data chip you received into your systems. Unfortunately, the information is in an alien language, so you set it aside and work on a plan to salvage the <EDC-ship>. Gathering some notes on the ship and the number of crew they were carrying, it's clear that you will need to carry at least 66 additional crew that you can communicate with to be able to salvage it. The closest system that comes to mind with many human speakers is on Greenwater, in Hai space.
units.italian: Invece di intromettervi nel loro dolore, tornate alla vostra nave e inserite il chip dati ricevuto nei vostri sistemi. Purtroppo le informazioni sono in una lingua aliena, così lo mettete da parte e lavorate a un piano per recuperare la <EDC-ship>. Mettendo insieme qualche nota sulla nave e sul numero di persone che trasportava, è chiaro che vi serviranno almeno 66 membri d'equipaggio in più con cui poter comunicare per riuscire a recuperarla. Il sistema più vicino che vi venga in mente con molti parlanti umani è su Greenwater, nello spazio Hai.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 5|name|437|0
units.english: <EDC-ship> salvage team
units.italian: <EDC-ship> salvage team

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 5|description|438|0
units.english: Hire a <bunks> member salvage team on <destination> to salvage the Efreti ship <EDC-ship>.
units.italian: Assolda una squadra di recupero di <bunks> persone su <destination> per recuperare la nave Efreti <EDC-ship>.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 5|blocked|443|0
units.english: You need <bunks> available bunks to carry the salvage team.
units.italian: Vi servono <bunks> cuccette libere per trasportare la squadra di recupero.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 5|Many stories tell of Hai who like change and excitement, but their enthusiasm seems to have died. Thoughts of the species that invaded them still inspire fear. No Hai have the courage to salvage a ship that has been caught in the crossfire of the Mereti and Sestor war.|450|0
units.english: Many stories tell of Hai who like change and excitement, but their enthusiasm seems to have died. Thoughts of the species that invaded them still inspire fear. No Hai have the courage to salvage a ship that has been caught in the crossfire of the Mereti and Sestor war.
units.italian: Molte storie parlano di Hai a cui piacciono il cambiamento e l'eccitazione, ma il loro entusiasmo sembra morto. Il pensiero della specie che li ha invasi ispira ancora paura. Nessun Hai ha il coraggio di recuperare una nave finita nel fuoco incrociato della guerra fra Mereti e Sestor.

units.id: mission:Efreti: Distress Call 5|	Fortunately, there are plenty of humans who are willing to risk it for the right pay, even given the comfortable life they have in Hai space. You show the new crew members to their bunks and prepare to salvage the <EDC-ship>.|451|0
units.english: Fortunately, there are plenty of humans who are willing to risk it for the right pay, even given the comfortable life they have in Hai space. You show the new crew members to their bunks and prepare to salvage the <EDC-ship>.
units.italian: Per fortuna ci sono molti umani disposti a rischiare per il giusto compenso, anche con la vita comoda che hanno nello spazio Hai. Accompagnate i nuovi membri dell'equipaggio alle loro cuccette e vi preparate a recuperare la <EDC-ship>.
